user.title: D200 Deck
user.description: How should Home Assistant reach D200 Deck? MQTT needs the MQTT integration on the same broker as the deck. The Web API needs the plugin Web API switched on in D200 Deck (Packages, Web API) and its token.

data.base_topic: Base topic (as in D200 Deck: Packages, Deck, MQTT)

web.title: Web API
web.description: The computer running D200 Deck, and the token from Packages, Web API. Presses come back to a Home Assistant webhook, which the integration registers with the deck.

data.host: Host (name or address of the computer)

entities.title: Entities on the deck
entities.description: Pick the entities to put on the deck; you can change them later. On the deck, use the app Home Assistant (MQTT) or Web key (Web API) and pick the entity's id.

error.invalid_topic: A topic without + or #, e.g. d200.
error.cannot_connect: The deck did not answer. Is D200 Deck running, with Run the web server on?

abort.already_configured: This D200 Deck is already set up.

init.title: Entities on the deck
init.description: Each entity becomes an id you can put on any key: with the app Home Assistant (MQTT) or Web key (Web API). Taking one off removes it from the deck.

data.default_actions: A press runs the entity's default action (toggle, run the scene, press the button)

notify.name: Notify
notify.description: Shows a notification on the wide key.
